description:
Get nightly sleep from the local cache: bed and wake time, total sleep, deep/light/REM/awake time, naps, sleep score with quality and Garmin's feedback, awake count, average respiration and sleep stress. JSON mode adds the sleep score's components (duration, stress, deep/light/REM %, restlessness, awake count) with Garmin's rating each.

A night belongs to the date you woke up. Defaults to the last 14 nights, at most 92 per call.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_get_sleep
title: Sleep
